verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only glancing support. Make's docs list a "scenario history" topic and a "clone a scenario" option, which could serve as manual snapshots. An audit-log API endpoint and MCP/API tools to view and modify scenarios offer some reviewability. Missing for 10: explicit scenario version history ("scenario history" may mean run history rather than versions), diff or review of changes, one-click rollback to a prior version, Git-style or API-based versioning for AI-native workflows, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
